title: Manton's Exotic Vortex Equation
summary: In this paper, we study the equation which we call Manton's exotic vortex equation. The equation arose in Manton's study of a deformation of the classical vortex equation [Ma]. We first investigate the existence problem for Manton's exotic vortex equation and establish existence results. We then construct the moduli space of solutions. Finally, we establish a dimensional reduction for Manton's exotic vortex equation.
